title: CaRE：掩码扩散语言模型的计算感知重掩码评估协议
summary: CaRE是一个计算感知的评估框架，用于审计掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的重掩码策略。它通过标准化实际函数评估次数、强制执行多指标报告并显式控制随机性，揭示了温度对MAUVE方差的主导作用、计算匹配比较会逆转已发表的策略排名，以及高熵重掩码会降低MAUVE。该框架确保未来重掩码声明的可重复性和可比性。
summary_en: CaRE is a compute-aware evaluation framework that audits MDLM remasking strategies by standardizing NFE, enforcing multi-metric reporting, and controlling stochasticity. It reveals that temperature dominates MAUVE variance, compute-matched comparisons reverse published rankings, and high-entropy remasking reduces MAUVE. It ensures reproducible and comparable remasking claims.
